description: Ministry of Local Government - By-Laws of the Horana Municipal Council and Agalawaththa Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the notification and detailed description of new by-laws for regulating public latrines in the Horana Urban Council area. It constitutes subsidiary legislation made under the authority of the Urban Council Ordinance, falling under the category of Legal/Regulatory matters (new regulations and regulatory frameworks). While it mentions the Governor's approval, this is procedural for enacting the regulations rather than being the main focus, which is the regulatory content itself.
